Auth._comment: Development placeholders. Startup FAILS outside Development while these contain 'dev-only' â€” supply real secrets via environment variables or a secret store.

Sms._comment: Provider=Log prints the code to the console. Provider=Msg91 with AuthKey and TemplateId is the production path - a DLT-registered aggregator, which is what Indian carriers require of transactional SMS. Provider=Gateway posts to a self-hosted gateway instead (SMS Gateway for Android on a spare handset with its own SIM, or a GSM modem): free and open source, fine for development and a pilot, not for volume - one SIM is rate-limited by its carrier and has no DLT header. Production refuses to start on Log.
Sms.MessageTemplate: {code} is your ParkNest verification code. It expires in 5 minutes. Do not share it with anyone.

Messaging._comment: Provider=InProcess dispatches events to handlers in this process and needs nothing installed. Provider=RabbitMq routes them through the broker in docker-compose; switch when the modules stop sharing a process.

Storage._comment: Provider=Local keeps listing photos on this machine's disk and serves them from PublicPath. Two API instances do not share a directory, so switch to object storage before running more than one. Provider=None disables photo upload.

Kyc._comment: Pepper keys the hash of every document number stored. Startup FAILS outside Development while it is missing, short or still says dev-only. RequireDocumentPhoto=false only where photo storage is unconfigured, otherwise a number typed into a form is all anyone has to prove.

Push._comment: Provider=None stores and sockets notifications without pushing to a handset, and is allowed in Production - a missing Firebase project costs a buzz, not a message. Provider=Firebase needs ProjectId and a service account key file downloaded from Firebase console - Project settings - Service accounts; never commit the key.

Cache._comment: Shared cache in front of geo-search. Provider=None runs every search against PostGIS, which is inside its latency budget for one city. Provider=Memory caches within this process - the whole benefit on a single instance, and stale on every other one. Provider=Redis is the multi-city answer. SearchTtlSeconds caps staleness; listing publishes and withdrawals invalidate explicitly. OriginPrecision is decimal places of latitude/longitude in the cache key - 4 is about 11 metres, and without rounding the cache never hits because GPS jitter mints a new key per tap.

Payments._comment: Provider=Sandbox runs the built-in local gateway - no account, no money, refused in Production. Provider=Razorpay takes real payments and needs KeyId, KeySecret and WebhookSecret; never commit those, use environment variables or a secret store. Provider=None disables payments entirely.
